machop_1.name: Machop
dialog: It's carrying a lump of coal nearly as big as itself.

worker.name: Worker
dialog: I met my Machop up on Route 207, the pair of them.
There's nobody I'd rather have beside me at the coal face.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Worker Colin: Go on, then. A quick one while I'm on my break!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Worker Colin: Back to it. I tell you, I'd sooner be out on the road with my Pokémon, like you.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Worker Mason: Keep it quiet, but I brought my Pokémon to work with me today!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Worker Mason: Well, aren't you something! Right. Back to the coal, me and my partner.
